# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(corncob)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#make bracken files list
bracken_files <- list.files(path = here("bracken_output/"), pattern = "Bracken_Species", full.names = TRUE)

#read in files
bracken_list <- lapply(bracken_files, read.table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

#rename objects in list
names(bracken_list) <- gsub("^(In_\\d+)_.*", "\\1", 
                            basename(bracken_files))
  
# Make a big table
bracken_df <- bracken_list %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "SampleID") %>% 
  filter(name != 'Homo sapiens')

#read in metadata
monsoon_levels <- c("before","after") #create levels

meta <- read.csv(here("metadata/india_metadata.csv"), row.names = 1) %>% 
  select(!sample) %>% 
  mutate(monsoon = factor(monsoon, levels = monsoon_levels))
meta <- sample_data(meta)
```

## Wrangle data

```{r}
#select sample ID, taxa, and estimated reads
bracken_est_reads <- bracken_df %>% 
  select(SampleID, name, new_est_reads) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = SampleID, values_from = new_est_reads) %>% 
  mutate(across(2:11, ~as.numeric(replace_na(.x, 0))))

#select sample ID, taxa, and relative abundances
bracken_rel_abundance <- bracken_df %>% 
  select(SampleID, name, fraction_total_reads) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = SampleID, 
              values_from = fraction_total_reads) %>% 
  mutate(across(2:11, ~as.numeric(replace_na(.x, 0))))

write_tsv(bracken_rel_abundance, 
          here("bracken_output/combined_data/
               species_relative_abundances.tsv"))
```

# Phyloseq

## Create objects

```{r}
#make sure taxa are rownames
feature_table <- as.data.frame(bracken_est_reads)
rownames(feature_table) <- feature_table$name
feature_table$name <- NULL

# Make otu_table
otu <- otu_table(as.matrix(feature_table), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

# Make taxonomy table
taxonomy <- data.frame(
  Genus = sapply(strsplit(rownames(feature_table), " "), `[`, 1),
  Species = sapply(rownames(feature_table), function(x) {
    parts <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) >= 3 && parts[2] == "sp.") {
      return(parts[3])  # Take the third part if second part is 'sp.'
    } else if (length(parts) >= 2) {
      return(parts[2])  # Normally take the second part
    } else {
      return(NA)  # If weird formatting
    }
  })
)
rownames(taxonomy) <- rownames(feature_table)
taxonomy <- tax_table(as.matrix(taxonomy))


#assemble
ps <- phyloseq(otu,taxonomy,meta)
```

## Alpha diversity

```{r}
#calculate diversity measures
alpha_df <- estimate_richness(ps, measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed"))
alpha_df$SampleID <- rownames(alpha_df)

# Merge with sample metadata
alpha_df <- cbind(alpha_df, as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame"))

```

```{r}
#plot shannon alpha diversity

alpha_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = monsoon, y = Shannon, color = monsoon)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Shannon Diversity", y = "Shannon Index", x = "Sample") +
  ggthemes::theme_clean()

ggsave(here("figures/shannon_alpha_diversity.tiff"))
```

```{r}
#plot simpson alpha diversity
alpha_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = monsoon, y = Simpson, color = monsoon)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Simpson Diversity", y = "Simpson Index", x = "Sample") +
  ggthemes::theme_clean()

ggsave(here("figures/simpson_alpha_diversity.tiff"))
```

## Beta diversity

```{r}
# Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
ord_bc <- ordinate(ps, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

```

```{r}
#plot ordination
plot_ordination(ps, ord_bc, color = "monsoon") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis)") +
  ggthemes::theme_clean()

ggsave(here("figures/pcoa_bray-curtis.tiff"))
```

```{r}
#see if distances are significant

# Extract Bray-Curtis distance matrix
bc_dist <- phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "bray")
metadata <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

adonis2(bc_dist ~ monsoon, data = metadata)

```

```{r}
# Step 2: Extract sample coordinates
ord_df <- plot_ordination(ps, ord_bc, justDF = TRUE)

# Step 3: Merge with metadata (optional, if not already in ord_df)
metadata <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
ord_df_full <- cbind(ord_df, metadata[rownames(ord_df), ])

# Step 4: Run envfit using only the ordination coordinates
# IMPORTANT: Only the coordinate columns (usually the first 2 columns)
ordination_coords <- ord_df[, 1:2]
colnames(ordination_coords) <- c("Axis.1", "Axis.2")  # ensure clean names

envfit_result <- envfit(ordination_coords, metadata, permutations = 999)
```

```{r}
# Extract arrow data from envfit
factor_scores <- scores(envfit_result, display = "factors")
centroids_df <- as.data.frame(factor_scores) %>% tail(2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(ord_df, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = monsoon)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = centroids_df, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2), 
             shape = 4, size = 5, stroke = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = centroids_df, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, 
                                     label = rownames(centroids_df)),
            vjust = -1, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) with Group Centroids",
       x = "PCoA Axis 1", y = "PCoA Axis 2") +
  ggthemes::theme_clean()

ggsave(here("figures/pcoa_centroids.tiff"))
```

## Differential abundance

```{r}
#differentially abundant taxa
ps_genus <- ps %>% tax_glom("Genus")
ps_species <- ps %>% tax_glom("Species")

set.seed(1)
da_analysis <- differentialTest(formula = ~ monsoon,
                                 phi.formula = ~ monsoon,
                                 formula_null = ~ 1,
                                 phi.formula_null = ~ monsoon,
                                 test = "Wald", boot = FALSE,
                                 data = ps_species,
                                 fdr_cutoff = 0)

da_analysis$significant_taxa 
```

```{r}
#differentially variable taxa
set.seed(1)
dv_analysis <- differentialTest(formula = ~ monsoon,
                                 phi.formula = ~ monsoon,
                                 formula_null = ~ monsoon,
                                 phi.formula_null = ~ 1,
                                 data = ps_species,
                                 test = "LRT", boot = FALSE,
                                 fdr_cutoff = 0)

dv_analysis$significant_taxa

```

# Visualize abundances

```{r}
physeq_genus <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Genus")
physeq_genus_rel <- transform_sample_counts(physeq_genus, 
                                            function(x) x / sum(x))

plot_bar(physeq_genus_rel, fill = "Genus") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylab("Relative Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
bracken_df %>% 
  mutate(Genus = str_extract(name, "^\\S+"),
         SampleID = as.factor(SampleID)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(SampleID,fraction_total_reads,fill = Genus)) +
  geom_col(stat = 'identity', position = 'fill') +
  ggthemes::theme_clean() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("Genus Relative Abundance") +
  xlab("Sample")

ggsave(here("figures/genus_relative_abundance.tiff"))
```

```{r}
bracken_df %>% mutate(SampleID = as.numeric(SampleID)) %>% 
arrange(SampleID) %>% 
  mutate(Genus = str_extract(name, "^\\S+"),
         SampleID = as.factor(SampleID)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(SampleID,fraction_total_reads,fill = Genus)) +
  geom_col(stat = 'identity')
```

```{r}
bracken_df %>%

  ylab("Genus Relative Abundance") +
  xlab("Sample")

ggsave(here("figures/genus_relative_abundance_top.tiff"),

```

```{r}
bracken_df %>% 
  arrange(desc(fraction_total_reads)) %>% 
  head(100) %>% 
  mutate(Genus = str_extract(name, "^\\S+"),
         SampleID = as.factor(SampleID)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(SampleID,fraction_total_reads,fill = name)) +
  geom_col(stat = 'identity', position = 'fill') +
  ggthemes::theme_clean() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)) +  
  ylab("Genus Relative Abundance") +

ggsave(here("figures/species_relative_abundance_top.tiff"),
```
